scope: The red-sandstone Nanyue Palace Garden Hall at the Zhongshan Fourth Road entrance to the Palace and Garden exhibition site, at the east end of the Guangzhou palace precinct.

originalReview.notes: 2024 street view showing rust-red stone courses, small vertical dark openings, bold plain upper massing and the ground-level base and glazing. Exact direct upload by the photographer under CC0.

quallaSearch.notes: The only published Qualla exterior depicts the Palace and Garden branch. Its published file matches the native creator’s own-work CC0 upload. The other story photographs depict collection objects.
